notes.title: Navicula Meatus Demo Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
18/10/24


 The unhelpful hint room can now be accessed (kinda).
 Added some fauna.
 Fired the bartender, hired new bartender.
 Adjusted some paintings.
 Fixed a bug relating to doors.
 Fixed a bug relating to holding controller buttons.
 Made some areas a little brighter.


If you experience any weird bugs or problems let me know in the discussion board. Thanks to everyone who has checked out the demo! :)
